notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[h2]Drops of Death will release in October 2025! 🎃[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38618055/1a82037889ff9df6c659333964f56de9484cddd8.png[/img]


We've been working hard to bring the world a killer dating sim, and now we are far enough along that we can confidently announce our release date. We're so excited to share more with you soon! 

Until then, you can find more fun Drops of Death content on our [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@snowhavenstudios]Tiktok[/url].

notes.title: Drops of Death - Progress Update
notes.notes:
[b]We’re making steady progress on  Drops of Death, a murder mystery VN where the killer is randomly chosen at the start of the game–with a romantic twist where players can date the killer.[/b]

We’ve been working on the routes for the main cast, including Detective Singh, Fawn, Edwin, and Natasha. The new artwork for these characters is also a work in progress, including the main character Adrien, an MC with customizable pronouns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38618055/7e0f1405a2b9f3f2bd64a691caf8e3b499af5603.png[/img]

We’re happy to share these character CGs! Enjoy~ And we hope you look forward to more Drops of Death updates coming soon!
